title: DamianJoda's Woodsaw
description: This project adds a stonecutter equivalent "woodsaw" for all wood types!
body:
## 📘 DESCRIPTION
Ever wondered why they never added a stonecutter equivalent for wood? This mod fixes that!

This mod adds a Woodsaw functional block. This is a stonecutter equivalent for all wood types! Cut logs, planks, and more into stairs, slabs, doors, fences, and other wood products with ease. Work exactly the same as the stonecutter.

Accompanying this new block is a Woodworker villager and the respective Woodworkers houses for each village type (same style/frequency as mason houses).

Supports only Fabric

## ✨ FEATURES
- New Woodsaw functional block.
- New Woodworker villager profession for Woodsaw blocks.
- New Woodworker villager houses for each village type.

## ⚙️ INSTALLATION
- Download the latest .jar file from the versions tab.
- Download the required mods from the Dependencies tab.
- Place the mods in the appropriate folder. (e.g. %appdata%/.minecraft/)

## ❗ DEPENDENCIES
Fabric API

## 📜 CREDITS
@ModdingByKaupenjoe

## MORE
Won't receive more features but will possibly receive:
- Bugfixes/(re)balancing.
- Other game versions.
